brief: Prioritise Ashford Hill 138/13kV (SUB-SGW-881) for pre-event attention ahead of younger units, as its advanced age and high loading history leave it with a reduced margin against mechanical failure under thermal stress [MG-023]. Where the unit cannot be attended before the forecast event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure [MG-023]. On events extending beyond 48 hours with overnight minima above 24 degrees, apply a further 5 percent reduction from the third day onward [MG-021].
